shortDescription: Manage HA group settings on a BIG-IP system

options.name: active_bonus
options.description: Specifies the extra value to be added to the HA score of the active unit. When system creates HA group this value is set to C(10) by the system.

options.name: enable
options.description: When set to C(false), the system disables the HA score feature.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the HA group to create/manage.

options.name: pools
options.description: Specifies pools to contribute to the HA score. The pools must exist on the BIG-IP, otherwise the operation will fail.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the resource exists. When C(absent), ensures the resource is removed.

options.name: trunks
options.description: Specifies trunks to contribute to the HA score. The trunks must exist on the BIG-IP, otherwise the operation will fail.
